annotations.title: Company filings: SEC financials, filings and insider trades

description: Official company data from the SEC: up to 15 years of financials from 10-K and 10-Q filings, every filing with links (8-K items explained), and insider buys and sells from Form 4. By ticker or company name. Use it when: Researching a US-listed company: revenue, profit, margins and cash flow over time, what it has filed (earnings, executive changes, deals), or whether insiders are buying or selling. Not for: Share prices, private companies, or companies that do not file with the SEC. Data, not investment advice. Returns: Depends on the action; see the actions table. Every answer includes the company profile (name, CIK, tickers, exchange, industry, fiscal year end). Typical time: about 2 s. Actions: us_financials (income statement, cash flow and balance sheet figures by year or quarter, with margins; needs company); us_filings (every filing, filtered by form and date, back to the 1990s; needs company); us_insider_trades (insider buys, sells, grants and exercises from form 4; needs company). Price: from $0.003 per lookup, charged only on success. Price depends on action: us_filings $0.003, us_financials $0.005, us_insider_trades $0.008 (default us_financials). One call = one company lookup (financials, filings or insider trades).

action.description: What to get; each has its own price

company.description: A ticker (AAPL), a company name (Apple) or an SEC CIK number. US-listed and SEC-registered companies

days.description: us_insider_trades: how far back to look. Default 90

form.description: us_filings: only these forms, comma separated, e.g. 8-K or 10-K,10-Q

limit.description: us_filings: most filings to list (default 20). us_insider_trades: most Form 4 filings to read (default 25, max 40)

open_market_only.description: us_insider_trades: only open-market buys and sells, no grants or exercises

since.description: us_filings: filed on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

until.description: us_filings: filed on or before this date

years.description: us_financials: how many periods back. Default 5 years or 8 quarters
